tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ngor lugs 'jigs byed drug cu pa'i skabs su nyer mkho'i yi ge bzhugs so// bla ma dang khro rgyal rdo rje 'jigs byed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya na bla ma gong ma'i phyag len la sku rim chen mo dang stabs bstun sgrub sde gong 'og lu spe sogs nas 'dus grwa kha shas 'jigs byed drug cu'i gtor bzlog mdzad srol 'dug kyang / 'don cha dang phyag len ngor lugs yin pa la ha cang gi khungs thub zhig mi 'dug pa nas lcags sbrul dang chu rta lo zhal dkar rje drung ngag dbang shes rab la nged rang nas 'jigs byed sgrub thabs dang / gtor bzlog ngor chen yab sras kyi gsung dang mthun pa nag 'gros gsar brtsoms zhig zhus don bzhin mdzad pa 'di ka sor bzhag la gdan sa 'dir gtor sgrub bskang ba gang la'ang sa lo chen po'i phyag len khyab che bas de dang phyogs mtshungs/ 'jigs byed drug cu gtong tshul lag deb zur gsal de rang nas bkod pa bzhin dang / 'dir de la nye bar mkho ba'i gser skyems dpang gzugs dang zor lam dbye ba/ sngar nas gdong phrol las gshin bstod bskul bzlog pa rnams phyogs rol dang bkra shis bcas 'dri ba la/ thog mar gser skyems ni bdud rtsi byin rlabs sgrub thabs bzhin byas la/ phyogs bcu rgyal ba sras bcas kyis/ /sku gsung thugs yon phrin las dang / /mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i ngo bo nyid/ /dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams/ /gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ /bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyis/ /ci bsam don kun 'grub pa dang / /dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /gcig du bsdus pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir ma he'i zhal/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed lha tshogs rnams/ /gser skyems༞ /bdag cag yon mchod༞ /ci bsam don kun༞ /dgra bgegs sgrol༞ /las bzhi sgrub la thog med cing /

/mchog dang thun mong kun bstsol ba/ /rab 'byams rgyud sde rnam bzhi yis/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ /gser skyems gtsang༞ /bdag cag yon mchod༞ /ci bsam don kun༞ /dgra bgegs༞ /sa skya'i rje btsun bstan bsrung mchog /mgon po che chung 'khor bcas dang / /nor skyong dkar bdud phur srung sogs/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs bcas rnams/ /gser skyems༞ /bdag cag༞ /ci bsam༞ /dgra bgegs༞ /gshin rje gshed kyi rnam sprul las/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i tshul 'dzin pa/ /dregs pa'i ded dpon phyogs skyong bcu/ /sprul pa yang sprul 'khor bcas rnams/ /gser skyems༞ /bdag cag༞ /ci bsam༞ /dgra bgegs༞ /'chi bdag nag po gshin rje'i gshed/ /ma mo yi dbang tsa munt+ri/ /gshed bzhi ma bzhi sgrol gying bzhi/ /dregs pa'i dmar tshogs 'khor bcas rnams/ /gser skyems༞ /bdag cag༞ /ci bsam༞ /dgra bgegs༞ /gzhan yang bstan bsrung 'jig rten skyong / /'khor 'das tshul 'chang mthu bo che/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan pa/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad rnams/ /gser skyems༞ /bdag cag༞ /ci bsam༞ /dgra bgegs༞ /sa yi lha mo bstan ma dang / /bod skyong bstan ma bcu gnyis dang / /gnas bdag gzhi bdag yul bdag dang / /grong bdag dkor bdag 'khor bcas rnams/ /gser skyems༞ /bdag cag༞ /ci bsam༞ /dgra bgegs༞ /gzhan yang dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i/ /'phrin las sgrub la bar gcod pa'i/ /gdon bgegs logs 'dren thams cad kyang / /gser skyems 'di yi tshims byas nas/ /rnal 'byor bka' las ma 'da' ba/ /rang rang gnas su 'gro bar gyis/ /oṃ ā hūm̐ sarba bighnan gatstsha/ gser skyems 'dis mjug gi shlau ka phyed dang gnyis sngags bcas sa lo'i mgon po'i gser skyems nas 'byung ba bzhin dang de gong rnams nged rang nas gsar brtsoms/ dpang gzugs ni slob dpon ḍoṃ bhi was mdzad pa'i dus mtha'i cho ga las/ hūm̐/

'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /las kyi gshin rje gshin rje'i 'khor dang bcas/ /phyogs skyong rgyal chen sde brgyad bran g.yog bcas/ /ma mo gying chen pho nya'i tshogs rnams nyon/ /bstan pa bshig pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di/ /sems can yongs la 'tshe byed 'di yin gyi/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig byed 'di yin gyi/ /dkon mchog dbu 'phang smod byed 'di yin gyi/ /bla ma dam pa'i sku dgra 'di yin gyi/ /rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i bar chad 'dis byas kyi/ /'di 'dra nam yang bzhag pa ma gsungs pas/ /da lta nyid du bsad cing bsgral bar bskul/ /'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje yab yum bskul/ /phyogs bzhir las kyi gshed bzhi 'khor bcas bskul/ /mtshams bzhir srid pa'i ma bzhi 'khor bcas bskul/ /sgo bzhir sgrol ba'i gying bzhi 'khor bcas bskul/ /rgyal chen bzhi dang gza' brgyad 'khor bcas bskul/ /klu chen brgyad dang lha brgyad 'khor bcas bskul/ /tshangs pa la sogs phyogs skyong 'khor bcas bskul/ /rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'khor bcas bskul/ /'di la mgon dang bsrung skyobs ma mdzad par/ /bdag gi ma nyes gzu dang dpang po mdzod/ /zor lam dbye ba ni/ ldong ston gyi las byang nas 'byung ba bzhin la phyis kyi mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gi cung zad rgyas su btang ba ni/ hūm̐ nga ni sangs rgyas kun gyi ngos/ /'jam dpal khros pa gshin rje gshed/ /dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral ba'i phyir/ /de ring gdug pa'i zor 'phen gyis/ /bstan pa yongs kyi bsrung ma dang / /sems can phan byed dge la spro/ /dkar po'i phyogs la dga' ba yi/ /'byung po thams cad sku gzur gcig /mtho ba rnams kyi zhabs bsdus shig /steng gi lha rnams zhabs bsdus shig /dma' ba rnams kyi dbu chums shig /sa bdag klu gnyen dbu chums shig /bar pa rnams ni sku gzur cig /lha srin sde brgyad sku gzur gcig /yul lha gzhi bdag sku gzur cig

/sems g.yeng rnams kyang rnam par bsgrim/ /'gro 'dod bskyod pa ma nus rnams/ /ko long phrag dog ma mdzad cig /zor ni khyod la mi 'phen no/ /zor ni dgra dang bgegs la 'phen/ /bsrung ma dam can dmag dpung bskyed/ /dgra bgegs yul du dmag drongs la/ /dgra bgegs ma lus rdul du rlog /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /las gshin gyi bstod bskul bzlog pa'i rim pa ni/ hūm̐ khams gsum sems can kun gyi srog gi bdud/ /gang gi lus dang grib ma tshul bzhin du/ /kun gyi ltag pa'i phyogs na gnas pa yi/ /mche bzhi gtsigs pa can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di slob dpon gzhon nu zla bas mdzad/ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /khrag gi rgya mtsho chen po'i rba klong na/ /keng rus skam rlon brtsegs pa'i khri steng na/ /bdud 'dul drag po chos kyi rgyal po'i sku/ /spyan rtsa dmar po gyen du ldog pa yis/ /thog ser dus gcig 'bebs pa'i mthu bo che/ /shangs nas rdo rje'i 'tshub ma byung ba yis/ /khams gsum 'thor zhing zhal nas hūm̐ phaṭa sgrogs/ /sku mdog mthing nag 'od zer 'bar ba'i sku/ /rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad 'khor bcas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /shlau ka phyed dang gsum po 'di bram ze mchog srid kyis mdzad/ bcom ldan chos rje 'jam dbyangs spyan lam du/ /bdud 'dul bstan pa srung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /las kyi gshin rje ma mo mkha' 'gro ma/ /'byung po ro langs ci bgyi'i bka' nyan tshogs/ /phyi nang skyong ba'i dam can ma lus la/ /bdag gi re ba'i sems kyi 'dud cing mchis/ /shlau ka phyed dang gnyis po 'di slob dpon zhi ba ye shes kyi mdzad/ bstod bskul thor bu ba phyogs sgrigs pa 'di bzhin thar gling ārya de was chos rgyal bcu gsum ma'i mchod chog nas 'byung / bzlog pa ni ldong ston gyi las byang las/ hūm̐ chos kyi rgyal po sku bskyod la/ /steng gi ltas ngan dgra la bzlog

/bzlog go drag po'i dpung gi bzlog /bsgyur ro ltas ngan cho 'phrul bsgyur/ /ya ba ti yang༞ /shar gyi ltas ngan༞ /bzlog go༞ /bsgyur ro༞ /gshin rje phya sangs༞ /lho'i༞ /bzlog go༞ /bsgyur ro༞ /gshin rje rmigs pa༞ /nub kyi༞ /bzlog go༞ /bsgyur ro༞ /ral pa tshar dgu༞ /byang gi༞ /bzlog go༞ /bsgyur ro༞ /kā la rā tri༞ /shar lho'i༞ /bzlog go༞ /bsgyur ro༞ /gsod byed nag mo༞ /lho nub༞ /bzlog go༞ /bsgyur ro༞ /nag mo chen mo༞ /nub byang༞ /bzlog go༞ /bsgyur ro༞ /nam gru chen mo༞ /byang shar༞ /bzlog go༞ /bsgyur ro༞ /tsa mun tri ya༞ /'og gi༞ /bzlog go༞ /bsgyur ro༞ /ya ma da ti sku bskyod la/ /dgra bgegs thams cad 'dug par gyis/ /kā la pa sha༞ /dgra bgegs thams cad 'chings bar gyis/ /ya ma danḍi༞ /dgra bgegs thams cad bsad par gyis/ /ya ma daṇḍi༞ dgra bgegs thams cad za bar gyis/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i dgra yul du/ /smyo 'bog rgyal thabs sna tshogs dang / /rim dang shu ba 'brum bu thongs/ /byis pa chung rabs rtse nas chod/ /gza' chen brgyad po sku bskyod la/ /sdang bar byed pa'i dgra yul du/ /thog ser sa g.yos byang rdzi bskyod/ /mu ge'i skal pa me ltar sbor/ /klu chen brgyad kyi dgra yul du/ /mdze nad skya sbabs sna tshogs thong / /sha chod rus pa dum bur khrol/ /khrag rol rnag gi rgya mtsho dkyil/ /phyogs skyong bcu dang lha brgyad dang / /rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad sogs/ /dregs pa thams cad sku bskyod la/ /dgra bo'i rigs brgyud rtsad nas chod/ /bzlog go༞ /bsgyur ro༞ /yas kyi bdud g.yos dgra la bzlog /mas kyi sri langs༞ /pha mtshan rgya 'dre༞ /nye ba'i byol po༞ /rgya gar ngan sngags dgra la༞ /bon po'i bon zor༞ /suṃ pa'i glang zor༞ /bod kyi dmod tshig༞ /byad dang rbod gtong༞ /skag dang dgra gshad dgra la bzlog /bzlog go drag po'i dpung gis bzlog /bsgyur ro ltas ngan cho 'phrul bsgyur/

/ces ldong ston las byang las 'byung ba'i bzlog pa 'di la gtso 'khor rnams kyi mtshan bskyed mchog dang mthun nged rang nas bsgyur ba'o/ /bkra shis ni/ 'khor lo'i mgon po bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /rol pa'i rdo rje rā chen lo tsā sogs/ /mkhas grub brgyud pa brjod dam dran kyang rung / /bkra shis 'phel zhing skye dgu bde legs shog /srung 'khor dur khrod drag po'i pho brang dbus/ /pad nyi bdud bzhi gdong drug nad gdon steng / /rab brjid khro rgyal rdo rje 'jigs byed skus/ /bkra shis༞ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung zhing 'jig rten skyong / /tshangs dbang byin za gshin rje srin po klu/ /rlung lha nor bdag dbang ldan sa lha yis/ /bkra shis༞ /dkar nag las kyi shan 'byed gzigs ldan sras/ /srid pa'i ma mo yum mchog tsa munt+ri/ /gshed bzhi ma bzhi gying bzhi 'khor bcas kyi/ /bkra shis 'phel zhing skye dgu bde legs shog /gshin rje gshed rgyud rtsa bshad snying po'i don/ /smin grol lam bzang cha lag bcas pa la/ thos bsam sgom pa 'grub gnyis dge legs kyis/ /bkra shis༞ /ces 'jigs byed drug cu'i gtor bzlog skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i rnam gzhag nyung ngu bkra shis dang bcas pa 'di yang sa skya pa dag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis bris/ bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling mtha' rgyas shog /maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ ngor lugs 'jigs byed drug cu pa'i skabs su nyer mkho'i yi ge/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
